messages:
Maria Chen: SOC2 + ISO evidence intake is open. Internal teams must upload artifacts by 2024-05-07; contractors by 2024-05-10. Auditor: Kumquat Associates. Use portal: https://compliance.internal.redwood/inbox (select 'SOC2-2024 intake').

Alex Rivera: Quick Q: for infra, do you want exported policies or raw logs?

Maria Chen: Exported policy files + one example log (redacted) covering the window. For S3 include `aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket <name> --query Policy` output or equivalent. No PII in uploads.

Priya Singh: Some contractors are in APAC on PTO. Can we extend? Also staging SSL renewals mid-May  will that affect intake?

Maria Chen: Contractors allowed until 2024-05-10. If cert renewals fall after cutoff, upload the renewal ticket + current cert screenshot.

Todd Hale: Naming: prefix files with SOC22024_<team>_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>_<owneremail>. Tag any tickets with SOC2-2024. Kumquat will sample ~10% of artifacts.

Jenna Ortiz: Reminder: privacy course "Data Handling Basics" must be completed by 2024-05-01. People Ops will auto-assign and send reminders. If you completed last year, confirm under Portal > Training > Attestations.

compliance-bot: Automated reminder: 5 days until internal evidence deadline (2024-05-07). You have outstanding items in the portal: https://compliance.internal.redwood/queue

Alex Rivera: I'll upload infra artifacts EOD. Can someone paste the short checklist?

Maria Chen: Checklist: 1) IAM role screenshots + principals list; 2) S3 policy export + ACL screenshot; 3) example redacted app logs; 4) public endpoint configs; 5) training attestations screenshot. See Confluence FAQ: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/COMPLIANCE/SOC2+2024+Intake

Maria Chen: If blockers, open TICKET and tag SOC2-2024. I'll consolidate and confirm submissions with Kumquat on 2024-05-08.
